info.name: nopCommerce Sales Analytics
info.summary: nopCommerce Sales Analytics & Reporting Studio for Nextcloud
info.description: Synchronizes raw e-commerce entities (orders, customers, products, shipments) from nopCommerce via REST APIs and Webhooks, stores them locally, and generates executive KPI dashboards, sales summaries, time-series trends, customer segmentation, bestseller rankings, and automated report exports.
info.author: NopStation
